title: Welcome to Aetheria
body: Aetheria is your clean-air companion during winter smog. This top bar stays visible on every screen so you can always see your current air status and get help.

title: Live AQI Status Pill
body: This pill shows the live US AQI category using four colours: Green (0–25 Pristine), Teal (26–75 Temperate), Amber (76–150 Smog Intrusion), and Crimson (151+ Hazardous). Tap it to view live breakdown details.

title: Language Selector
body: Tap here to switch Aetheria into any language—including Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Spanish, Arabic, Swahili, or any language you type. Both text and voice adapt automatically.

title: Interactive Help & Tutorial
body: Tap the question mark anytime to open the Tutorial Library, replay this guided tour, or ask how any feature works.

title: Household Profile & Settings
body: Tap your profile avatar to tell Aetheria about your family (infants, seniors, asthma), your cooking fuel, commute mode, and location so every recommendation is personalised.

title: Your Live Location
body: Tap your city name to switch cities or re-detect your GPS position. All air quality readings, forecasts, and routines update immediately for the selected area.

title: Ambient AQI Crown Dial
body: The dial displays live US AQI, PM2.5 concentration, and how many times higher it is than the WHO 24-hour safe guideline (15 µg/m³). Underneath is the source and exact update time.

title: Best Ventilation Window
body: Calculated from hourly PM2.5 and atmospheric boundary-layer forecasts, this card shows the cleanest time to open windows. Tap 'Remind me' to schedule an alert.

title: Windows Sealed & Purifier Status
body: Toggle whether your windows are sealed and whether a purifier or DIY box-fan filter is running. Changing these immediately recalculates your indoor PM2.5 estimate.

title: GenAI Daily Low-Emission Routine
body: Your morning-to-evening schedule generated from today's forecast and your household profile. Check off each step as you complete it to update your impact totals.

title: Direct Personal Impact & Transparency
body: See estimated CO₂ spared, PM2.5 exposure avoided, and money saved today. Tap any metric card to open the exact formula and inputs used to calculate it.

title: Meet the GenAI Smog Oracle
body: Switch to Oracle to ask any question about winter smog, safe indoor hacks, masks, or commuting. Tap any suggested chip to start instantly.

title: Ask, Speak, or Scan a Room
body: Type your question, tap the microphone to speak in your language, or tap the scanner icon to upload a photo of your room, stove, mask, or filter for AI inspection.

title: Customise Oracle Answers
body: Tap the tune button to choose short vs detailed answers, set a budget cap, or turn on kid-friendly and elderly-friendly tailoring.

title: Neighbourhood Clean Air Guild
body: See how your local area is tackling winter smog together. All counters show verified community pledges recorded in your area.

title: Live Local Pollution Map
body: Explore real-time air quality markers around your neighbourhood using OpenStreetMap and live station/grid data.

title: Take a Clean-Air Pledge
body: Join a pledge such as stopping open waste burning, switching to LPG/induction, or carpooling. Pledging updates the live counter and unlocks achievement badges.

title: Indoor Hacks & Sustainable Vault
body: Filter practical playbooks like DIY box-fan filters, window sealing, and honest evidence notes—plus your Saved bookmarks tab.

title: Sustainable Alternatives Comparator
body: Compare your current cooking fuel and commute mode against cleaner alternatives with transparent cost and CO₂ deltas based on your profile.

title: Household Sanctuary Checklist
body: Complete quick daily readiness checks. Every item checked improves your Sanctuary impact score.

title: Asthma & Vulnerability Shield
body: Manage vulnerable family members, see their safe AQI threshold, log medication doses and symptoms, and access one-tap emergency calling and location sharing.

title: Thermal Inversion & School Alerts
body: Understand when cold ground air traps smog under a warm atmospheric lid, check off midday school protections, and generate a parent/school alert in your language.

title: Clean-Air Walking Route Navigator
body: Compare walking corridors ranked by total PM2.5 inhalation exposure (concentration × time), follow live voice-guided waypoints, or share your ETA.

title: Global Multilingual Voice Assistant
body: Tap this floating microphone button on any screen to navigate, check air quality, log an inhaler dose, switch languages, or ask the Oracle hands-free!
